---

```http
POST /v1/chat/{id}/conversations
```

Opens a conversation with the visitor's first message and returns a session `token`. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every later call for that conversation; it is shown once and kept only as a hash. - A browser's `Origin` (or `Referer`) must be one of the chat's allowed origins, or the call is `403 origin_not_allowed`. - Limits per address, per chat and per workspace answer `429` with `Retry-After`. - The message is scored for spam and checked against the workspace's filters; anything that would be held is `422 spam_rejected`. - `email` is optional. Without it an answer cannot reach a visitor who has left.

## Authentication

None. This endpoint is public: it is called by browsers or mail clients, never with your API key.

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | &nbsp; |

## Request body

Content type: `application/json`. Required.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | no | at most 80 characters. |
| `email` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `message` | string | yes | at most 2000 characters. |
| `identity` | string | no | Hex HMAC-SHA256 of the lower-cased email, made by the website own server with the identity secret of the chat. With it the email is trusted and the conversation is marked identified. |

Example:

```json
{
  "message": "string"
}
```

		log.Fatal(err)

	fmt.Println(res.StatusCode, string(out))
}

## Responses

### 201

Started

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conversation_id` | string (uuid) | no | &nbsp; |
| `token` | string | no | &nbsp; |

```json
{
  "conversation_id": "6f1c2d0e-3b52-4d49-9a43-7d1f0c5e8a11",
  "token": "string"
}
```

### 403

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "origin_not_allowed"
  }
}
```

### 404

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "chat_disabled"
  }
}
```

### 422

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_email"
  }
}
```

### 429

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limited"
  }
}
```

## Error codes

Errors share one shape: `error.code` is stable, `error.message` is optional detail. Retry only timeouts, network errors, `429` and `5xx`, with the same idempotency key; fix the request for every other `4xx`.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `chat_disabled` | 404 | Chat: the operator has not turned live chat on |
| `not_found` | 404 | Unknown id, or one that belongs to another project or environment |
| `origin_not_allowed` | 403 | Forms: the page's origin is not one of the form's allowed origins |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | A limit was reached. See `Retry-After` |
| `invalid_email` | 422 | Contacts: the address is not valid |
| `empty_message` | 422 | Chat: the message is empty |
| `message_too_long` | 422 | Chat: a message is longer than 2000 characters |
| `spam_rejected` | 422 | Forms: the message looks like spam and was not kept |
| `identity_invalid` | 422 | Chat: the signed identity does not match the email address (or no email was sent with it) |
| `identity_required` | 422 | Chat: this chat only takes visitors the website has identified |
| `visitor_banned` | 403 | Chat: an agent banned this visitor |
| `invalid_request` | 422 | Unreadable JSON, unknown field, or a missing required field |
| `service_unavailable` | 503 | Storage was unavailable. Nothing was accepted |

Every code is explained on [Rate limits and errors](/docs/api/rate-limits-and-errors).
